global_prompt: Maintain the same fictional character Mira, teal raincoat, orange backpack, face, proportions and storybook-cinematic 3D style. Natural motion, soft daylight, consistent forest geography, no text or logos.

scenes.prompt: Mira, a fictional young explorer with a teal raincoat and orange backpack, walks along a forest path in gentle morning light.
Mira pauses beside a small wooden bridge and looks at the stream flowing below.
Mira carefully crosses the bridge while leaves drift across the path.
Mira notices a tiny red bird on a mossy branch and watches quietly.
Mira follows the path toward a sunlit clearing with ferns and wildflowers.
